missing_value: Source NA becomes null in storage and in memory; no imputation.

gauge_id.description: catchment identifier (8-digit USGS hydrologic unit code)

gauge_name.description: gauge name, followed by the state

runoff_ratio.description: runoff ratio (ratio of mean daily discharge to mean daily precipitation)

slope_fdc.description: slope of the flow duration curve (between the log-transformed 33rd and 66th streamflow percentiles)

baseflow_index.description: baseflow index (ratio of mean daily baseflow to mean daily discharge, hydrograph separation performed using Ladson et al. [2013] digital filter)

stream_elas.description: streamflow precipitation elasticity (sensitivity of streamflow to changes in precipitation at the annual time scale)
stream_elas.references: Eq. 7 in Sankarasubramanian et al. (2001), the last element being P/Q not Q/P

high_q_freq.description: frequency of high-flow days ( > 9 times the median daily flow)
high_q_freq.references: Clausen and Biggs (2000), Table 2 in Westerberg and McMillan (2015)

high_q_dur.description: average duration of high-flow events (number of consecutive days > 9 times the median daily flow)
high_q_dur.references: Clausen and Biggs (2000), Table 2 in Westerberg and McMillan (2015)

low_q_freq.description: frequency of low-flow days ( < 0.2 times the mean daily flow)
low_q_freq.references: Olden and Poff (2003), Table 2 in Westerberg and McMillan (2015)

low_q_dur.description: average duration of low-flow events (number of consecutive days < 0.2 times the mean daily flow)
low_q_dur.references: Olden and Poff (2003), Table 2 in Westerberg and McMillan (2015)

zero_q_freq.description: frequency of days with Q = 0 mm/day

hfd_mean.description: mean half flow date (date on which the cumulative discharge since October 1st reaches half of the annual discharge)

soil_depth_pelletier.section: camels_soil - Soil characteristics - *: Only covers the top 1.5 m

soil_depth_statsgo.description: soil depth (maximum 1.5m, layers marked as water and bedrock were excluded)
soil_depth_statsgo.section: camels_soil - Soil characteristics - *: Only covers the top 1.5 m

soil_porosity.description: volumetric porosity (saturated volumetric water content estimated using a multiple linear regression based on sand and clay fraction for the layers marked as USDA soil texture class and a default value [0.9] for layers marked as organic material, layers marked as water, bedrock and "other" were excluded)
soil_porosity.references: Table 4 in Cosby et al. (1984), Lawrence and Slater (2008)
soil_porosity.section: camels_soil - Soil characteristics - *: Only covers the top 1.5 m

soil_conductivity.description: saturated hydraulic conductivity (estimated using a multiple linear regression based on sand and clay fraction for the layers marked as USDA soil texture class and a default value [36cm/hr] for layers marked as organic material, layers marked as water, bedrock and "other" were excluded)
soil_conductivity.references: Table 4 in Cosby et al. (1984), Lawrence and Slater (2008)
soil_conductivity.section: camels_soil - Soil characteristics - *: Only covers the top 1.5 m

max_water_content.description: maximum water content (combination of porosity and soil_depth_statgso, layers marked as water, bedrock and "other" were excluded)
max_water_content.section: camels_soil - Soil characteristics - *: Only covers the top 1.5 m

sand_frac.description: sand fraction (of the soil material smaller than 2 mm, layers marked as oragnic material, water, bedrock and "other" were excluded)
sand_frac.section: camels_soil - Soil characteristics - *: Only covers the top 1.5 m

silt_frac.description: silt fraction (of the soil material smaller than 2 mm, layers marked as oragnic material, water, bedrock and "other" were excluded)
silt_frac.section: camels_soil - Soil characteristics - *: Only covers the top 1.5 m

clay_frac.description: clay fraction (of the soil material smaller than 2 mm, layers marked as oragnic material, water, bedrock and "other" were excluded)
clay_frac.section: camels_soil - Soil characteristics - *: Only covers the top 1.5 m

water_frac.description: fraction of the top 1.5m marked as water (class 14 )
water_frac.section: camels_soil - Soil characteristics - *: Only covers the top 1.5 m

organic_frac.description: fraction of soil_depth_statsgo marked as organic material (class 13)
organic_frac.section: camels_soil - Soil characteristics - *: Only covers the top 1.5 m

other_frac.description: fraction of soil_depth_statsgo marked as other (class 16)
other_frac.section: camels_soil - Soil characteristics - *: Only covers the top 1.5 m

p_mean.section: camels_clim - Climate indices - *: Computed over the period 1989/10/01 to 2009/09/30

pet_mean.description: mean daily PET [estimated by N15 using Priestley-Taylor formulation calibrated for each catchment]
pet_mean.section: camels_clim - Climate indices - *: Computed over the period 1989/10/01 to 2009/09/30

p_seasonality.description: seasonality and timing of precipitation (estimated using sine curves to represent the annual temperature and preciptiation cycles, positive [negative] values indicate that precipitation peaks in summer [winter], values close to 0 indicate uniform precipitation throughout the year)
p_seasonality.section: camels_clim - Climate indices - *: Computed over the period 1989/10/01 to 2009/09/30

frac_snow.description: fraction of precipitation falling as snow (i.e., on days colder than 0°C)
frac_snow.section: camels_clim - Climate indices - *: Computed over the period 1989/10/01 to 2009/09/30

aridity.description: aridity (PET/P, ratio of mean PET [estimated by N15 using Priestley-Taylor formulation calibrated for each catchment] to mean precipitation)
aridity.section: camels_clim - Climate indices - *: Computed over the period 1989/10/01 to 2009/09/30

high_prec_freq.description: frequency of high precipitation days ( >= 5 times mean daily precipitation)
high_prec_freq.section: camels_clim - Climate indices - *: Computed over the period 1989/10/01 to 2009/09/30

high_prec_dur.description: average duration of high precipitation events (number of consecutive days >= 5 times mean daily precipitation)
high_prec_dur.section: camels_clim - Climate indices - *: Computed over the period 1989/10/01 to 2009/09/30

high_prec_timing.description: season during which most high precipitation days ( >= 5 times mean daily precip.) occur
high_prec_timing.section: camels_clim - Climate indices - *: Computed over the period 1989/10/01 to 2009/09/30

low_prec_freq.section: camels_clim - Climate indices - *: Computed over the period 1989/10/01 to 2009/09/30

low_prec_dur.description: average duration of dry periods (number of consecutive days <1 mm/day)
low_prec_dur.section: camels_clim - Climate indices - *: Computed over the period 1989/10/01 to 2009/09/30

low_prec_timing.description: season during which most dry days ( <1 mm/day) occur
low_prec_timing.section: camels_clim - Climate indices - *: Computed over the period 1989/10/01 to 2009/09/30

frac_forest.section: camels_vege - Land cover characteristics - *: Period 2002 to 2014

lai_max.description: maximum monthly mean of the leaf area index (based on 12 monthly means)
lai_max.section: camels_vege - Land cover characteristics - *: Period 2002 to 2014

lai_diff.description: difference between the maximum and mimumum monthly mean of the leaf area index (based on 12 monthly means)
lai_diff.section: camels_vege - Land cover characteristics - *: Period 2002 to 2014

gvf_max.description: maximum monthly mean of the green vegetation fraction (based on 12 monthly means)
gvf_max.section: camels_vege - Land cover characteristics - *: Period 2002 to 2014

gvf_diff.description: difference between the maximum and mimumum monthly mean of the green vegetation fraction (based on 12 monthly means)
gvf_diff.section: camels_vege - Land cover characteristics - *: Period 2002 to 2014

dom_land_cover_frac.description: fraction of the catchment area associated with the dominant land cover
dom_land_cover_frac.section: camels_vege - Land cover characteristics - *: Period 2002 to 2014

dom_land_cover.description: dominant land cover type (Noah-modified 20-category IGBP-MODIS land cover)
dom_land_cover.section: camels_vege - Land cover characteristics - *: Period 2002 to 2014

root_depth_50.description: root depth (percentiles XX = 50 and 99% extracted from a root depth distribution based on IGBP land cover)
root_depth_50.section: camels_vege - Land cover characteristics - *: Period 2002 to 2014

root_depth_99.description: root depth (percentiles XX = 50 and 99% extracted from a root depth distribution based on IGBP land cover)
root_depth_99.section: camels_vege - Land cover characteristics - *: Period 2002 to 2014

geol_1st_class.description: most common geologic class in the catchment

glim_1st_class_frac.description: fraction of the catchment area associated with its most common geologic class

geol_2nd_class.description: 2nd most common geologic class in the catchment

glim_2nd_class_frac.description: fraction of the catchment area associated with its 2nd most common geologic class

carbonate_rocks_frac.description: fraction of the catchment area characterized as "Carbonate sedimentary rocks"
